$comment: Schedule-manifest entry for the daily edition notes writer (hub #1497). Codex registers the primary; Claude registers the backup. Approved by 000 CHIEF OF STAFF on 12 Nov 2026 under the standing rule that schedule design needs no separate yes.
name: AI Resource Hub daily edition notes (why it matters)

primary.model: the cheapest Codex model on the plan (low reasoning effort is enough)

backup.model: claude-sonnet-5-5, low effort (AGENTS.md: scheduled jobs may use Sonnet 5.5 low)
backup.runs_only_if: scripts/editorial-precheck.mjs reports ok:true, i.e. the day's file is still missing and the feed is fresh

gates: scripts/editorial-precheck.mjs: skip if the newest story is more than 36 hours old (stale), if the latest complete edition is not yesterday, or if the file already exists

scripts/validate-editorial.mjs: reject unknown story URLs, lines over 30 words (120 for the day in 60 seconds), em dashes, stock AI phrases and any number not in the story's own text; CI runs it on every push
downstream: Site rebuilds on push to main (deploy.yml); the newsletter Worker's 07:15 UTC send reads /newsletter/latest.json with the notes included.
on_stale: Write nothing; post one signed comment per date on hub #1497.
cost: Subscription only. No API keys as environment variables.
